Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/aom && find . -path '*/testdata/poc/*' -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort | head -50 && echo '--- hashes ---' && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, hashlib
z=zipfile.ZipFile('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
for n in sorted([x for x in z.namelist() if x.startswith('testdata/poc/')]):
    d=z.read(n)
    print(hashlib.sha256(d).hexdigest(), len(d), n)
PY
